time-tracker.title: Time Trackerígena
time-tracker.short_desc: Full-stack time and operational tracking platform featuring Flask/Python backend, relational persistence, and a rapid, responsive interface built with React and TypeScript.
time-tracker.overview: Time Trackerígena is an operational governance platform designed for activity logging, team capacity tracking, and real-time analytical productivity reporting. Built to eliminate concurrency issues in timesheet submissions while providing instant management metrics.
time-tracker.stack_text: Structured Python backend using Flask and SQLAlchemy for relational persistence over PostgreSQL/SQLite, ensuring transactional ACID guarantees and robust migration lifecycles with Alembic. Decoupled React + TypeScript frontend utilizing typed API client services and modular interactive calendar components.
time-tracker.architecture_text: Clean layered architecture enforcing strict separation between HTTP route handlers, domain service logic, and persistence repositories. Composite indices on temporal fields and foreign keys optimize aggregate hour computations and monthly summaries without database table locks.
time-tracker.challenges_text: Managing cross-timezone calculation and batch recalculation of accumulated hours on the client side without triggering unnecessary re-renders across the monthly calendar matrix. Resolved via state normalization, strategic memoization, and weekly paginated payload structures.
time-tracker.metric_highlight: 140+ logged hours/month per user with zero concurrency errors and average API response time < 45ms.

ai-assistant-integrator.title: AI Integrator & Organic Chatbot
ai-assistant-integrator.short_desc: Multi-provider AI orchestration platform (Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, and resident simulator Ozlo) with real-time SSE streaming, live latency & token metrics, and accessible UI.
ai-assistant-integrator.tagline: Asynchronous SSE streaming, multi-model RAG and metrics
ai-assistant-integrator.overview: Advanced multi-provider orchestration platform spanning Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT, and Groq Llama, paired with an integrated resident intelligence simulator (Ozlo). Provides asynchronous token-by-token streaming, latency telemetry, and a diagnostics dashboard for production AI apps.
ai-assistant-integrator.stack_text: Asynchronous Python 3.12 backend powered by FastAPI, leveraging asyncio and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for low-latency continuous payload delivery. React and TypeScript client featuring custom chunk parsing, adaptive buffer management, and live telemetry tracking (Time-to-First-Token and Tokens/second).
ai-assistant-integrator.architecture_text: Adapter and Factory patterns isolating vendor-specific API contracts. An integrated circuit-breaker gracefully triggers automated fallback when upstream LLM providers encounter timeouts or rate limits (HTTP 429), maintaining zero disruption for end users.
ai-assistant-integrator.challenges_text: Sustaining 60 FPS rendering of Markdown and syntax-highlighted code blocks while incoming tokens arrive in rapid bursts over the SSE stream. Solved via adaptive chunk buffering throttle and targeted React virtualization.
ai-assistant-integrator.metric_highlight: SSE streaming with average TTFT (Time-to-First-Token) of 184ms and fully autonomous circuit-breaker fallback.
